```{r}
library(ggplot2)
```


#inputs

```{r}
N = 100
K = 10000
M = 500
a1 = 1.5
a2 = .1
b0 = 1 #should always be one
sigma = 1
mu = 3
eta = 1
Y0_1 <- 0
Y1_1 <- 0
a <- 1
b <- 2
```

##CAR1 function

```{r}
Car_2Recovery <- function(a1, a2, Y, M) {
  lambda1 <- (-a1 + sqrt(a1^2 - 4*a2)) / 2
  lambda2 <- (-a1 - sqrt(a1^2 - 4*a2)) / 2
  YRecov <- numeric(length(Y) - 1)
  for (i in 2:(length(Y))){
    YRecov[i] <- (1 / (lambda2 - lambda1)) * (-lambda1 * Y[i] + (M * (Y[i]-Y[i-1])))
  }
  out <- YRecov
}
```


```{r}
CAR1<-function(a,sigma,N,K,noise,Y0)
{
  Y <-numeric(N*K+100000);
  Y[1] <- Y0;
  Dt=1/K;
  for(i in 2:(N*K+100000)){
    Y[i] <- Y[i-1]- a*Y[i-1]*Dt + sigma*noise[i];
  }
  out<-Y[100000:(N*K+100000)]
}
```

```{r}
Car1Recovery <- function(a1, a2, Y, M) {
  lambda1 <- (-a1 + sqrt(a1^2 - 4*a2)) / 2
  lambda2 <- (-a1 - sqrt(a1^2 - 4*a2)) / 2
  Kappa1 <- (b0) / (lambda1-lambda2)
  Kappa2 <- (b0) / (lambda2-lambda1)
  YRecov <- numeric(length(Y) - 1)
  for (i in 2:(length(Y))){
    YRecov[i] <- (1 / (lambda2 - lambda1)) * (lambda2 * Y[i] - (M * (Y[i]-Y[i-1])))
  }
  out <- YRecov
}
```

```{r}
CAR1Real <- function(a1, a2, noise, eta) {
  lambda1 <- (-a1 + sqrt(a1^2 - 4*a2)) / 2
  lambda2 <- (-a1 - sqrt(a1^2 - 4*a2)) / 2
  Kappa1 <- (b0) / (lambda1-lambda2)
  Y1REAL <- CAR1(-lambda1, Kappa1, N, K, noise, Y0_1)
  out <- Y1REAL
}
```

```{r}
CAR_2Real <- function(a1, a2, noise, eta) {
  lambda1 <- (-a1 + sqrt(a1^2 - 4*a2)) / 2
  lambda2 <- (-a1 - sqrt(a1^2 - 4*a2)) / 2
  Kappa2 <- (b0) / (lambda2-lambda1)
  Y2REAL <- CAR1(-lambda2, Kappa2, N, K, noise, Y0_1)
  out <- Y2REAL
}
```


##CAR2 approached from 2 dependent CAR1 processes

```{r}
CAR2 <- function(a1, a2, b0, noise, eta) {
  
  lambda1 <- (-a1 + sqrt(a1^2 - 4*a2)) / 2
  lambda2 <- (-a1 - sqrt(a1^2 - 4*a2)) / 2
  Kappa1 <- (b0) / (lambda1-lambda2)
  Kappa2 <- (b0) / (lambda2-lambda1)
  Y1 <- CAR1(-lambda1, Kappa1, N, K, noise, Y0_1)
  Y2 <- CAR1(-lambda2, Kappa2, N, K, noise, Y1_1)
  Y <- Y1 + Y2
  out <- Y
}

```


```{r}
NewCAR2 <- function(a1, a2, b0, N, K, noise, Y0 = 0, Y1 = 0)
{
  h <- 1 / K
  
  Y <- numeric(N * K + 100000)
  
  Y[1] <- Y0
  Y[2] <- Y1
  
  for(i in 2:(length(Y)-1))
  {
    Y[i+1] <-
      2 * Y[i] -
      Y[i-1] -
      a1 * h * (Y[i] - Y[i-1]) -
      a2 * h^2 * Y[i] +
      b0 * noise[i] * h
  }
  
  Y[100001:length(Y)]
}
```


##Approximated CAR 1 driving process recovery
```{r}
CAR1Driving <- function(a1, a2, Y1, M, N) {
  Lhat1 <- numeric(N-1)
  lambda1 <- (-a1 + sqrt(a1^2 - 4*a2)) / 2
  lambda2 <- (-a1 - sqrt(a1^2 - 4*a2)) / 2
  for (n in 1:(N-1)) {
    down = n * M - M + 1
    up = down + M
    Lhat1[n] <- (lambda2-lambda1) * (Y1[up] - Y1[down] + (-lambda1) * (Y1[up]+Y[down]) / (2 * M)
                                     + (-lambda1) * sum(Y1[(down+1):(up-1)]) / M)
  }
  out <- Lhat1
}
```


```{r}
CAR1_2Driving <- function(a1, a2, Y1, M, N) {
  Lhat1 <- numeric(N-1)
  lambda1 <- (-a1 + sqrt(a1^2 - 4*a2)) / 2
  lambda2 <- (-a1 - sqrt(a1^2 - 4*a2)) / 2
  for (n in 1:(N-1)) {
    down = n * M - M + 1
    up = down + M
    Lhat1[n] <- (lambda1-lambda2) * (Y1[up] - Y1[down] + (-lambda2) * (Y1[up]+Y[down]) / (2 * M)
                                     + (-lambda2) * sum(Y1[(down+1):(up-1)]) / M)
  }
  out <- Lhat1
}
```


###Recover CAR(1)s and driving process of CAR(1)s
```{r}
noise <- rnorm(N*K+100000,mu*(1/K),eta*(1/sqrt(K)));
##noise <- rgamma(N * K + 100000, a / K, b)
Y <- CAR2(a1, a2, b0, noise, eta)
YNew <- NewCAR2(a1, a2, b0, N, K, noise, Y0_1, Y1_1)
relation <- K / M
sample_index <- seq(
  1,
  length(Y),
  by = relation
)
YSampled <- Y[sample_index]
YReal <- CAR1Real(a1, a2, noise, eta)
YRealSampled <- YReal[sample_index]
Recov1 <- Car1Recovery(a1, a2, Y, M)
Recov1Sampled <- Recov1[sample_index]
Lhat1 <- CAR1Driving(a1, a2, Recov1Sampled, M, N)
timeV <- seq(1, length(Lhat1), by = 1)
LhatTrue <- CAR1Driving(a1, a2, YRealSampled, M, N)
df <- data.frame(timeV, Lhat1, LhatTrue)
ggplot(data = df) + geom_line(aes(x = timeV, y = Lhat1), colour = "red") + geom_line(aes(x = timeV, y = LhatTrue))+ labs(y = "Recovered CAR1 Lhat(red) vs true(black)", x = "time")
##For second recovered driving process
Y2Real <- CAR_2Real(a1, a2, noise, eta)
YRecov2 <- Car_2Recovery(a1, a2, Y, M)
Y2RealSampled <- Y2Real[sample_index]
YRecov2Sampled <- YRecov2[sample_index]
Lhat2 <- CAR1_2Driving(a1, a2, YRecov2Sampled, M, N)
Lhat2True <- CAR1_2Driving(a1, a2, Y2RealSampled, M, N)
ggplot(data = df) + geom_line(aes(x = timeV, y = Lhat2), colour = "red") + geom_line(aes(x = timeV, y = Lhat2True))+ labs(y = "Recovered CAR1 Lhat(red) vs true(black)", x = "time")
##Processes
timeVector <- seq(1, length(YRealSampled), by = 1)
df1 <- data.frame(timeVector, YRealSampled, Y2RealSampled, YRecov2Sampled, Recov1Sampled)
ggplot(data = df1) + geom_line(aes(x = timeVector, y = Recov1Sampled), colour = "red") + geom_line(aes(x = timeVector, y = YRealSampled))+ labs(y = "Recovered CAR1(red) vs true(black)", x = "time")
ggplot(data = df1) + geom_line(aes(x = timeVector, y = YRecov2Sampled), colour = "red") + geom_line(aes(x = timeVector, y = Y2RealSampled)) + labs(y = "Recovered CAR1(red) vs true(black)", x = "time")
##recov with difference
y2diff <- YSampled - Recov1Sampled
ggplot(data = df1) + geom_line(aes(x = timeVector, y = y2diff), colour = "red") + geom_line(aes(x = timeVector, y = Y2RealSampled)) + labs(y = "Recovered CAR1(red) vs true(black)", x = "time")
Lhat2Diff <- CAR1_2Driving(a1, a2, y2diff, M, N)
ggplot(data = df) + geom_line(aes(x = timeV, y = Lhat2Diff), colour = "red") + geom_line(aes(x = timeV, y = LhatTrue))+ labs(y = "Recovered CAR1 Lhat(red) vs true(black)", x = "time")
```


```{r}
CAR2Sum1 <- YRecov2Sampled + Recov1Sampled
ggplot(data = df1) + geom_line(aes(x = timeVector, y = CAR2Sum1), colour = "red") + geom_line(aes(x = timeVector, y = YSampled)) + labs(y = "Recovered CAR1(red) vs true(black)", x = "time")
```
